teacher_info.introduction:
Hello, My name is Kim and I am from Northampton in England, but am currently living in Italy. I have experience tutoring English Language and Literature, as well as conversational English. I was born in England and so am very familiar and happy to talk about, British life and customs, but have family in Asia that I try to visit as often as possible, and enjoy talking to people from all nationalities.

I have a degree in Early Childhood Studies from Warwick University in the UK, which has given me an extra insight into teaching not only children but adults as well. I’m a very patient person, and having been taught a second language from a young age, understand some of the difficulties that can come up. I’m actually currently trying to improve my grasp of Italian, and so can definitely sympathise with anyone wishing to do the same, and hope to be able to come up with practical solutions for both myself and anyone wishing to learn from me.

I am offering one-to-one tuition (via Skype) with students who wish to improve their English, with a loose lesson structure that is tailored to include whatever topics you would particularly like to focus on. Don’t worry if you’re not sure, I can help come up with suggestions based on your interests and areas you wish to improve on. I like to use different source materials like newspaper/magazine articles and YouTube videos, to encourage students to understand the use of English in different contexts, and to keep my lessons as interesting as possible. If this sounds like something you would be interested in then please do get in touch! Hope to see you soon!

My main goal is for you to enjoy the lessons, so learning English doesn't feel like a chore, and is actually fun!

pro_course_detail.title: ✅ Master a British Accent (Premium)
pro_course_detail.description:
➡️ Aimed at ESL students, academics, actors who wish to develop a British accent, public speakers, international businessmen and executives, diplomats, skilled professionals, call centre employees, people who work in service and hospitality industries, etc. 
➡️ Aimed at anyone who wishes to reduce their accent for communication purposes. 
➡️ Aimed at actors who wish to acquire a (southern) British accent.
➡️ Useful for children/teenagers learning English at school whose teacher may not be a native speaker. 
➡️ Students are recommended to purchase the books 'Get Rid of Your Accent: The English Pronunciation and Speech Training Manual' (Parts 1 and 2)  by Linda James and Olga Smith - please see me for details. There is also an app to accompany the series.
➡️ For students who have completed this series, or have studied pronunciation in depth already, we will follow the coursebook 'Pronunciation in Use' by Martin Hewings, published by Cambridge University Press, along with other materials.

Please note that there are very many accents in the UK, and this course focuses on just one of them (received pronunciation). My own accent is standard southern English.

pro_course_detail.title: ✅ English Literature: Language, Style and Plot in the Golden Age of Detective Fiction
pro_course_detail.description:
Whether you are already familiar with the classics from the Golden Age of Crime in your own language, or new to them altogether, let's meet our best-known sleuths as they unravel some of the most famous mysteries in the genre. Rather than the novels (which may seem onerous to complete), we will focus on short stories by Agatha Christie, Dorothy L. Sayers, Margery Allingham, Ngaio Marsh and many, many more.
The course involves a mixture of private reading outside the lesson time with reading out loud, discussion of language and plot analysis within the lesson itself. We will use illustrated presentations in the classes and fun quizzes at the end of each short story to consolidate vocabulary  and enhance understanding. Essays can be set if required.
Please contact me to discuss your requirements.
I am also open to other texts and authors of your suggestion, including modern, as I'm always looking for the next Queen of Crime!

pro_course_detail.title: ✅  Let's 'Give You an Edge' in English: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs and Proverbs
pro_course_detail.description:
➡️ Idiomatic expressions have long played an important role in the English
language and are so widespread that an understanding of them is essential to successful communication, in listening, speaking, reading and writing.
➡️ Without a working knowledge of such idioms, even the best student's speech can remain lacklustre, despite a good grounding in grammar and an extensive vocabulary.
➡️ Particularly useful for those who wish to live or work in an English-speaking country, where idioms and phrasal verbs may be used frequently in speech and so form part of everyday conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing & Proofreading: Essay, Job Application, PowerPoint, CV & Thesis Help
pro_course_detail.description:
It's difficult to get a job or complete an educational course in an English-speaking country when your written English isn't so great! So I will help your job application or essay stand out from the crowd by making sure that your grammar, spelling, vocabulary and sentence structure is in perfect English.

I have a university degree which required a lot of essay writing and have enjoyed creative writing since I was a child! So as well as correcting your English, I can offer constructive feedback on the quality of the work, the forcefulness of your argument and the tone of your writing - to make it as attractive as possible to the reader.

We can either go over your work together, or you can send me the text to correct myself. 

Please note that for work over 3000 words I will require more than 1 hour to complete it. If you have a long work which you would like me to proofread - message me before purchasing anything so that we can negotiate a price. 

I look forward to hearing from you!

pro_course_detail.title: Business English: Excelling In Your Workplace
pro_course_detail.description:
In these classes I will help you feel confident at work. In our first lesson, we will draw up a set of objectives for us to work towards over the coming days and weeks. It will be important for me to hear a little about the work that you do, so that I can get to know you and construct our lessons to give you exactly what you need.

We could work on: 
- Improving your conversational and written English for work
- Improving presentation skills. I may ask you to research a rival company and give me a presentation on how your company could compete with them, for example
- Practicing for real-life by role-playing office scenarios & meetings, with agendas, debates & business language
- Discussing issues around leadership, corporate responsibility & ethics - to improve your vocabulary in these areas
- Practicing how to talk to clients. Not all 'business' English is talking about work; sometimes you have to take a client to a restuarant and talk to them about the food! We can also practice this.

teacher_info.introduction:
Hi, I’m Tim, I’m a British English teacher and I have more than 8 years experience teaching English. 

I began teaching in 2009, in Argentina. I love language teaching and learning, I speak Spanish fluently and I’m learning Thai. I’ve been teaching students online since 2012. 

Most of my online students really want to focus on speaking. That’s why my teaching style aims to get you speaking and using English as much as possible. There is always a lot of discussion, interaction, and role-plays. My role as a teacher is to guide you, offer structure to learning and give you lots of opportunities to use English in a realistic way. 

I can guide you through a series of topics - so that you have the chance to learn, and practice speaking about a range of things. In the end you will be ready to have a conversation about any topic and clearly express your ideas in English. I’m there as your teacher to show you how to use English correctly and communicate effectively. I can give you expert feedback, highlight mistakes, and provide examples of correct usage and correct pronunciation.

 I like to use Google Docs as a shared document so that we can work together during the class, and make notes with feedback and corrections. At the end of the class you will have notes with new vocabulary and examples. 

Online classes make it really easy to use all of the great resources available on the internet. So, as well as using English student book, vocabulary and grammar materials, we’ll be able to take authentic English from news, magazines, videos and podcasts online. 

Teaching is my profession but it’s also my passion, and I look forward to sharing that passion with you and helping you step up to the advanced level and beyond.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation Classes
pro_course_detail.description:
IELTS Preparation Course - Reach the advanced levels

I offer two types of IELTS courses depending on how long you have until the test:

* Short term preparation
* Long term preparation course


Short term preparation: For students who will take the exam in the next month or two, we will focus on preparing you with real IELTS speaking and writing questions. We will alternate between classes focused on speaking and writing. For writing classes, you will complete a writing task 1 and 2 for homework, which we will discuss and analyse in the class, and I will show you how to improve your introductions, body paragraphs and conclusions to reach band 7 and higher. In speaking classes, I’ll give you targeted feedback and suggest useful phrases to help you get the best score possible on exam day. I can also offer tips on the reading and listening test, and we can discuss any problems you have with specific reading or listening tasks.

Long term preparation course: For students who have approximately 6 months before the test and want to focus on improving vocabulary and grammar, as well as work on speaking and writing skills, I offer a course where we will go through 20 common test topics. You’ll practise the following:

Listening tasks with test style questions.
Reading tasks with test style questions.
Vocabulary -  useful words and phrases for each topic.
Speaking - practice all speaking parts with test style questions on each topic.
Writing - practice writing and get feedback on how to improve the way you write to meet the IELTS standards.
Grammar - practice key grammar elements which will help you reach the advanced levels.

As an experienced teacher, I can help you quickly correct mistakes and improve your performance.  The aim is to get you speaking as much as possible and then offer feedback on how to improve. I’ve helped dozens of students prepare for IELTS with most aiming for and between bands 7 and 8. I hope I can help you too.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Improve your general English so you are ready to communicate effectively with native and non-native speakers in a wide range of situations. Move from a pre-intermediate to advanced English level. 

I offer different learning methods so we can choose the best method for you. We can use a variety of coursebook and associated materials, as well as using personally created and online materials. 

General English classes are ideal for most people who want to improve their English, especially speaking. All classes have a particular focus on speaking, with feedback on how to speak more naturally, and improve vocabulary.

We'll go through the course material together, and I'll give you feedback all the way. This type of class is a great way to include listening, reading and grammar activities, in addition to lots of speaking practice.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking Focused Classes
pro_course_detail.description:
The aim of these classes is to help you talk, a lot! You'll be able to speak, practice fluency and pronunciation, learn new vocabulary and try to use it effectively.

I've created over 50 discussion topics at intermediate and advanced levels with questions which we can discuss together. During the discussion I'll make notes for you with feedback on mistakes, vocabulary and grammar, and suggestions for better language. The aim of these classes is to get you speaking as much as possible, so I'll be asking lots of questions, and helping you with answers. You'll be able to practice speaking, pronunciation and fluency while you speak about a wide range of topics.

Intermediate level questions focus more on the use of B1 and B2 level vocabulary, while the advanced conversation lessons will include lots of questions with idioms and phrasal verbs as well as C1 and C2 vocabulary. You'll get a chance to use real English in interesting and fun conversations.

teacher_info.introduction: Hello! I'm Michael, and I have completed the highly regarded CELTA certificate in teaching English to foreign learners to get started teaching English. I have spent a lot of time learning since leaving school, starting with a year spent in China learning Kung Fu. It was whilst living there that my passion for languages really developed, and after studying Chemistry for one year at Imperial College London, I decided to focus on languages. Since then I have studied French and Chinese up to a conversational level, as well as maintaining my interest in other languages with lessons on italki and by attending events such as the Polyglot Gathering in Berlin. I first got into teaching by volunteering to tutor disadvantaged teenagers for their English exams, which was a great first experience of what it takes to plan lessons and monitor students' improvement. I also had a fantastic opportunity to design a course on Zoology myself for the Maya Universe Academy in Nepal, which was my first experience teaching whole classes. Finally, the CELTA course included 6 hours of meticulously observed teaching, which allowed me to practise teaching to a professional standard. In my own experience teaching and learning, a focus on communication when learning a language is key to improvement, so I like to teach mostly through conversation. However, I have good awareness of grammar and style in many written contexts, so I can also provide advice for job applications, personal statements, speeches etc. Just message me to tell me your learning goals, and I will tell you more about the lessons I can plan for you. Lessons are in English, as the best way to improve is through using the language, but beginners can speak French or Chinese if needed. I am offering informal tutoring while I continue to study teaching methods in preparation for teaching abroad, but professional lessons will be available in the future! pro_course_detail.title: TED Curriculum (50mins)
pro_course_detail.description:
Study and practice using the English language as it is really used by experts!

These classes are suitable if you are trying to level up your English, with a comprehensive focus on vocabulary, grammar, comprehension skills and native phrases. Each class we'll focus on one of the many fantastic TED speeches available freely online. I'll test your detailed understanding of the speaker to ensure you aren't missing anything, and you'll have the opportunity to analyse and respond to the ideas and proposals discussed.  

Throughout class I'll be sending you detailed language feedback and notes, both corrections and suggestions based on your own personal mistakes and also highlighting useful language from the speech.

pro_course_detail.title: Topic Discussion (30 / 45 / 60mins)
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn to communicate confidently and effectively in every situation, just like a native! 

Each class we will choose one topic for a highly focused discussion. The topic may be familiar for you or totally new, in either case I will challenge you to express yourself and engage with the conversation by asking questions that push you outside of your comfort zone. 

The lesson plan is simple: one topic, no grammar, no corrections. After 10 to 20 lessons, expect big improvements in your fluency and your confidence in sharing your thoughts.
